patch_description: Introduce a single-parameter CRX ring entangler on the outer perimeter in Layer 3. This replaces the CZ ring with 8 CRX gates sharing one parameter ("crx_ring"), increasing expressivity for ring interactions without exploding parameter count. Parameter sharing across the eight ring gates keeps the per-block parameter budget modest (adds one new parameter key), aiming to improve performance while keeping depth and gate count reasonable.
